d.title: Nanbaka 2
d.synopsis: The second part of Nanbaka. The prisoners and their guards continue their comfortable lives at Nanba Prison. However, from the shadows emerges a new threat: Enki Gokuu, a person from Samon's past, who has mysterious goals of his own.

rel.name: Nanbaka: Shusseki Bangou no Tsuita Baka-tachi!
